title: Wang Ping
summary: Four years later Wang Lin lives as a carpenter in Moonfall Village on Planet Ran Yun, raising Wang Ping, who has lost his past and drinks bitter medicine every day as Liu Mei's cure and Wang Lin's lightning slowly clear the resentment. Sun Tai brings him the record of every Celestial Ascension Fruit in the seventeen clans of Allheaven's Northern Domain, a fruit that can put even a giant beast to sleep for a hundred days, and Wang Lin promises to bury Sun Tai's ashes back in the Alliance. Wang Ping calls him Grandpa Sun and asks him to stay, and the old man settles next door. As the years pass, matchmakers keep chasing Wang Lin, he firmly refuses to let Wang Ping cultivate, and Sun Tai keeps trying to tempt the boy with corpse puppets and secret arts, but Wang Ping will not lie to his father. Living as a mortal makes Wang Lin's Dao heart clearer and his intent of life and death begins to change. After ten years Sun Tai dies at peace, Wang Ping carves his tomb, and after nineteen years in the village Wang Lin leaves to show his grown son the world.
